name: Hide-Out
body:
You have a hide-out you can seek refuge in when needed.

Prerequisite(s): Associate (an assassins guild).

Benefit(s): Anyone attempting Diplomacy or Survival checks to locate you takes a –10 penalty, and anyone attempting to scry upon you or magically divine your location must first succeed at a caster level check (DC = 15 + your character level). You can stay in your hide-out for up to 1 day per character level before you are forced to vacate.
